description_en: Queries the automatic backup cycle, backup time window, and level-1 backup retention period of a specified application
description_zh: 查询指定应用的自动备份周期、备份时间段和一级备份保留时长
name: DescribeApplicationBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The application type, such as polarclaw
parameters.name: application_type

ApplicationType.description_en: The application type, such as polarclaw

PreferredBackupPeriod.description_en: The days of the week when automatic backups are performed. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
PreferredBackupPeriod.description_zh: 自动备份执行的星期。多个值使用英文逗号分隔，取值为 Monday（周一）、Tuesday（周二）、Wednesday（周三）、Thursday（周四）、Friday（周五）、Saturday（周六）、Sunday（周日）

PreferredBackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The retention period of level-1 backups, in days
PreferredBackupRetentionPeriod.description_zh: 一级备份的保留时长，单位为天

PreferredBackupTime.description_en: The time window when automatic backups are performed. The time follows the HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format in UTC
PreferredBackupTime.description_zh: 自动备份执行的时间段，格式为 HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ，使用 UTC 时间
